Only shown/used when throw_type is On-On-On — real DPDT/3PDT on-on-on switches wire poles to throws differently between manufacturers (verified: no single standard exists), so this has NO default pattern and starts fully empty (see CLAUDE.md-style honesty note: don't presume a specific part's wiring).
